findings.remedy: Replace introduction with: Explicit compute entry selection, including source-order first selection.
findings.acceptance: Introduction accurately covers both First and Named without implying order independence for First.

verified_contracts: First chooses first Compute-stage entry; Named requires exact compute entry and has no fallback. MissingEntryPoint retains requested name or absence.
ComputeReflection owns selected compute entry identity and shared bind groups; dummy vertex/fragment fields and old ReflectionData removed.
prepare admits source/device and selected identity; compile/compiled use retained entry_point and validate_interface re-resolves that exact compute name against immutable source.
